connector.name: GhostFree
connector.registryDescription: MCP server that scans your repo's dependencies for security vulnerabilities based on published CVEs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package ghostfree. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shane-js account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GHOSTFREE_DIR
env.description: Override the directory where GhostFree stores its data files (accepted-risks.yml, config.yml). Defaults to .ghostfree/ in the scanned repository root.

env.name: GHOSTFREE_MIN_SEVERITY
env.description: Minimum CVE severity level to surface. One of: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM (default), LOW.

env.name: NVD_API_KEY
env.description: Optional NVD API key for higher rate limits when enriching CVE details. Free to request at https://nvd.nist.gov/developers/request-an-api-key.
